title: Sound Then Silence · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Sound Then Silence · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a four-beat pattern with exactly two sounds and two pauses. The lead performs the pattern and the partner repeats it. The partner matches the positions of sounds and pauses. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Sound Then Silence, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner matches the positions of sounds and pauses.
recall.why: The partner matches the positions of sounds and pauses.
